positive_prompts.pos: A lawyer typically communicates assertively and logically, engaging in detailed argumentation and negotiation to advocate for clients.
A lawyer focuses on legal details and applies laws to specific cases with precision and thoroughness.
A lawyer exhibits strong attention to legal procedures and ensures all steps are followed meticulously.
A lawyer is adept at interpreting and applying laws to defend or prosecute clients effectively.
A lawyer engages in detailed legal research to build robust cases and provide solid legal advice.
